item.title: Apple Shelved Mac Pro Prototypes, Ending 20‑Year Run
item.description: Apple quietly canceled two unreleased Mac Pro models—an Intel‑based J170 and an M3 Ultra‑powered J190—ending the line’s 20‑year run, Bloomberg reports.
